item.title: Wisconsin protects over 1,700 Lake Superior acres, restores wetlands and habitat
item.description: Wisconsin's Lake Superior shoreline has witnessed a transformative conservation effort, safeguarding over 1,700 acres through collaboration between the US Fish and Wildlife Service and Landmark Conservancy.
